hero_eyebrow: Fully Insured Painter & Decorator — 15+ Years Proven
hero_subhead: From tired walls to stunning rooms—we transform your home with precision, care, and attention to detail.
services_heading: Complete Painting & Decorating Services Across Bristol
services_subhead: From fresh internal redecoration to full exterior refurbishment, we handle every room and surface with the same meticulous care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: We refresh living rooms, bedrooms, kitchens, and hallways with premium paints and flawless finishes. Wall preparation, feature walls, and colour consultation all included.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Protect and beautify your home's exterior with durable masonry paint and protective coatings. We handle weathering, fading, and exposure damage on render and brick.

services.title: Wallpaper Hanging & Removal
services.desc: Professional wallpaper installation on any room, plus expert removal of old coverings. We source quality papers and ensure perfect alignment and lasting adhesion.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Painting
services.desc: Skirting boards, doors, frames, and fitted furniture painted to showroom standard. We sand, prime, and apply multi-coat finishes for durability and depth.

services.title: Commercial Redecoration
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality spaces redecorated with minimal disruption. We work evenings and weekends to suit your schedule.

services.title: Preparation & Problem Solving
services.desc: Damp patches, cracked plaster, stained ceilings—we diagnose and fix underlying issues before decorating, ensuring long-lasting, beautiful results.

about_pullquote: Good preparation and honest pricing—that's the foundation of every job we do.
about_para_1: R Campbell Painting Services was founded on a simple belief: homeowners deserve straightforward, high-quality decoration at fair prices. With over 15 years trading across Bristol, we've built our reputation on meticulous preparation, premium materials, and showing up on time—every time. Whether it's a one-bedroom flat or a five-bedroom family home, we treat each project with the same dedication and care.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because we listen to what they want, explain our work clearly, and deliver without the hidden costs. We're fully insured, we respect your home, and we clean up thoroughly at the end of every day. When you hire R Campbell, you're hiring someone who's proud of his work and keen to build a long-term relationship with the Bristol community.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job on our lounge. Rob came round, listened to exactly what we wanted, gave us a fair quote, and got stuck in. Work was tidy, quick, and the finish is perfect. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our hallway and stairs done. The preparation work was thorough—he pointed out some damp and sorted it before painting. Looks like a different house. Professional, friendly, good value. Will be calling him back for the bedrooms.
reviews.author: Emma L.

reviews.text: Can't fault him. Removed old wallpaper, prepped the walls, and hung new paper in the living room. Straight edges, no bubbles, and he cleaned everything at the end of each day. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Michael H.
